1 زَلَمَ , (aor.
زَلُمَ , inf. n. زَلْمٌ, TK,) He cut off one's nose [and app. anything projecting, or prominent: see 2: and see also 8]. (ISh, K.) ―
-b2- (assumed tropical:) He made his gift little, or small, in quantity or amount; (S, K;) [as though he cut off something from it;] in [some of the copies of] the S, [but not so in mine,] ↓ زلّم . (TA.) ―
-b3- He filled (S, K) a water-ing-trough, or tank, (S,) or a vessel; (K;) as also ↓ زلّم , inf. n. تَزْلِيمٌ. (AHn, K.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
